name: awesome-multiple-hypothesis-testing
description: Validation tools for Awesome Multiple Hypothesis Testing

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && python3 scripts/check_references.py
scripts.check:links: lychee --config lychee.toml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/*.md docs/publication-exceptions.json .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
scripts.check:links:offline: lychee --offline --config lychee.toml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/*.md docs/publication-exceptions.json .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
